proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9504 *bhiyantara explicitly gives Nepali bhitra, Maithili bhitrī and regional bhitar inside. These inside adverbs match that comparative family with its abhyantara-crossing qualification retained. Exact survey form bʰitərā is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
